title: Euan's Tools Pack
description: A lightweight utility pack with powerful client-side tools for testing, shortcuts, and creative control. Use with caution on servers.
body:
![Euan's Tools Pack banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9e0ce39d7cdc2005f214c905627b069ac28e0f40.png)_Utility-focused. Power at your fingertips._

My personal utility toolkit packed with handy client-side tools for quick testing, admin tasks, or just some extra control over your game. Whether you're hopping between accounts, tweaking commands, or just exploring the world more freely, this pack gives you powerful functionality without altering the core Minecraft experience.

- ✅ Command-based tools & shortcuts  
- ✅ Extra features for testing or creative use  
- ✅ No gameplay mechanics changed  
- ✅ Lightweight and functional
> ⚠️ **Server Notice:** Some of the included tools (*Auto Clicker*, *clientcommands*, *Freecam*, *No Shield Delay*) may be considered unfair or outright prohibited on many multiplayer servers. Always check the rules before using them in online environments to avoid being banned.

**Check out my other modpacks:**
* [Euan's Optimized Pack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/euans-optimized-pack)
* [Euan's QOL Pack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/euans-qol-pack)
